The fashion industry has once again solved the world’s most pressing problem: the burden of wearing actual fabric. By introducing "invisible jeans" made from 100% non-material, they have finally achieved the ultimate sustainable fashion goal—zero waste, because there is literally nothing to produce, ship, or recycle. These jeans are a marvel of modern engineering; they slim your figure by removing the visual clutter of denim entirely and shape your body by allowing the wind to pass through you unimpeded. Best of all, they make your wallet significantly lighter, not because they are cheap, but because you are paying for the privilege of being naked in public while pretending you are trendy. It is the perfect fit for every body type, provided your body type is "air."

Regarding your priority question: Pearls are typically found in mollusks, specifically oysters, clams, and mussels.
